AIDA Copywriting Formula
nodes.rationale: Attention-Interest-Desire-Action: Used for CTAs and closing slides. Template: '[Bold statement]. [Benefit detail]. [Social proof]. [CTA].' Evokes curiosity→confidence→urgency emotion arc.

nodes.label: PAS Copywriting Formula
nodes.rationale: Problem-Agitate-Solution: Used for problem slides and pain points. Template: '[Pain point]? Every [time frame], [consequence]. [Solution] fixes this.' Evokes frustration emotion.

nodes.label: FAB Copywriting Formula
nodes.rationale: Features-Advantages-Benefits: Used for feature slides and product showcases. Template: '[Feature] lets you [advantage], so you can [benefit].' Evokes confidence emotion.

nodes.label: Before-After-Bridge Formula
nodes.rationale: Before-After-Bridge: Used for transformation slides and case studies. Template: '[Pain point before]. [Desired state after]. [Your solution] is the bridge.' Evokes hope emotion.

nodes.label: YC Seed Deck Strategy
nodes.rationale: 10-slide pitch deck for raising seed funding from VCs. Emotion arc: curiosity→frustration→hope→confidence→trust→urgency. Slides: Title, Problem, Solution, Traction, Market, Product, Business Model, Team, Financials, The Ask.

nodes.label: Duarte Sparkline Pattern
nodes.rationale: Alternates between 'What Is' (current pain) and 'What Could Be' (better future) to transform perspective. Pattern: What Is→What Could Be→What Is→What Could Be→New Bliss. Pattern breaks at 1/3 and 2/3 positions create engagement peaks.

nodes.label: Sales Pitch Deck Strategy
nodes.rationale: 9-slide structure for closing deals with qualified leads. Emotion arc: connection→frustration→fear→hope→trust→confidence→urgency. Slides: Personalized Hook, Their Problem, Cost of Inaction, Solution, Proof, Differentiators, Pricing/ROI, Objection Handling, CTA.

nodes.label: Color Psychology System
nodes.rationale: Maps colors to psychological associations: Blue=Trust, Green=Growth, Red=Energy, Gold=Luxury, Purple=Creativity, Black=Sophistication, White=Purity. Includes industry-specific combinations and WCAG AA accessibility (4.5:1 contrast ratio).

nodes.label: Social Photos Design Workflow
nodes.rationale: 8-step workflow: Activate project management → Analyze requirements → Generate ideas → Design HTML files → Screenshot export via Chrome headless/Playwright/Puppeteer → Verify & fix → Generate summary report → Organize output. Platform-specific sizes from Instagram 1:1 to YouTube 16:9.

nodes.label: Slide Layout Decision Flow
nodes.rationale: 4-step decision flow: 1) What's slide goal? → Search layout-logic.csv. 2) What emotion? → Search color-logic.csv. 3) Content type? → Search typography.csv. 4) Break pattern? → Check position 1/3 or 2/3 → Use full-bleed.

nodes.label: Spec Kit Workflow
nodes.rationale: The Spec Kit is a feature specification workflow system: specify → clarify → plan → tasks → analyze → implement, with supporting commands for constitution, checklist, agent-context-update, and tasks-to-issues. The workflow is gated by constitution compliance and checklist validation.

nodes.label: Extension Hooks Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every speckit SKILL.md command implements the same extension hooks pattern: before_* / after_* hooks from .specify/extensions.yml. The hook system supports optional and mandatory hooks with dot-to-hyphen command name conversion and condition-skipping logic.

nodes.label: Project Constitution
nodes.rationale: Template-driven governance document at .specify/memory/constitution.md with placeholder tokens, semantic versioning (MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH), and consistency propagation across plan/spec/tasks templates. Constitution violations are automatically CRITICAL across all speckit commands.

nodes.label: Benchmark City Sources
nodes.rationale: Five benchmark cities (SF, NYC, Seattle, LA, Chicago) with documented source shapes, extraction paths, and gaps.

nodes.label: San Francisco Source Path
nodes.rationale: Primary: DataSF/Socrata parking meters (8vzz-qzz9) and meter policies (qq7v-hds4). OSM/osmtogeojson for garages/lots/zones. SFMTA page.

nodes.label: New York City Source Path
nodes.rationale: Primary: NYC Open Data/Socrata parking meters (693u-uax6) and regulation signs (nfid-uabd). NYC DOT rates page. Sign text needs LLM-assisted rule parser.

nodes.label: Seattle Source Path
nodes.rationale: Primary: Seattle Socrata paid parking occupancy (rke9-rsvs). ArcGIS Blockface FeatureServer for curb geometry. SDOT maps/data pages.

nodes.label: Los Angeles Source Path
nodes.rationale: Primary: DataLA/Socrata meter occupancy (e7h6-4a3e) and metered inventory/policies (s49e-q6j2). LA Express Park pages for rate program context.

nodes.label: Chicago Source Path
nodes.rationale: Primary: ParkChicago official web/app for rates. City of Chicago parking meters page. No confirmed open ETL source equivalent to SF/NYC/LA. Permit zones from Data.gov.

nodes.label: OSM as National Base Layer
nodes.rationale: OSM/Geofabrik for amenity=parking, street parking tags, geometry. ODbL obligations. Overpass+osmtogeojson for city-scale; osm2pgsql for production PBF imports.

nodes.label: Overture Maps as National Base Layer
nodes.rationale: Overture Maps for national POI discovery, address/name/category/brand matching. DuckDB over cloud GeoParquet for bounded metro extracts.

nodes.label: CurbLR and OMF Curb Data Specification
nodes.rationale: Target data model references for curb regulations, zones, policies. Internal normalized model that can later export to CurbLR/CDS.

nodes.label: Operator Networks
nodes.rationale: Targets: ABM Parking (2000+ locations), Parking.com/SP+, Premium Parking, SpotHero. Recommended acquisition: partner/API first, public page discovery, browser research, AI call/human review.
